situation: Freelance copywriter. A startup founder, Priya, offered $3,000 for a 12-page website, including the customer interviews we discussed. My rate would put it at $4,500. She says the budget is fixed.
reply: Thanks, Priya, I'd really like to write this one. For 12 pages with the customer interviews we discussed, my price is $4,500, and that's where I need to be to do it well. If $3,000 is fixed, I can scope to fit: the six core pages for $3,000 now, and the rest as a second phase when you're ready. Would that work?
note: Hold the rate, move the scope. Lowering the price for the same work resets every future quote.

situation: 我是自由设计师，给一家公司做品牌画册，合同是20页、1.5万元。市场部赵经理现在要加8页，截止日期不变。我想按原来的单价加钱，不想白做。
reply: 赵经理，新加的8页内容我看了，放进画册会更完整，我很乐意一起做。原合同是20页1.5万元，折合每页750元；新增的8页我按同样的单价，一共加6000元，截止日期不变。您看这部分能不能补一份确认，我今天就开始排版？如果这次预算只能加一部分，也可以先做最重要的4页，3000元，其余的放到下一期。
note: 范围变了价格就要跟着变：按原单价报一个具体数字，并提前给出缩小范围的选项，别默默多做。

situation: Ich will ein gebrauchtes Rennrad von Herrn Wagner kaufen, online für 850 Euro angeboten. Ich kann morgen bar zahlen und würde gern um die 700 bieten.
reply: Hallo Herr Wagner, das Rennrad interessiert mich sehr, und ich könnte es morgen Abend abholen. Würden Sie es für 720 Euro abgeben? Das liegt unter Ihrem Preis, dafür zahle ich bar und sofort.
note: Eine konkrete Zahl plus der echte Hebel (bar, morgen) wirkt besser als die Frage, ob am Preis noch etwas geht.

situation: I'm Ravi. The recruiter at Brackwell Insurance, Dee, just called with a verbal offer for the claims analytics lead role: $88k base, and she asked if I could say yes today. The posting listed $85k to $100k, I have six years in claims analytics, and I'd accept $93k. I want the offer in writing first and to answer by Tuesday 6 October.
reply: Hi Dee, thanks for the call this morning. I'm really pleased to get the offer and excited about the role. Before I answer, could you send the full offer in writing? I'll come back to you by Tuesday 6 October. So it isn't a surprise later: the base is at $88k, and with six years in claims analytics, which I'd bring to the team from day one, I was expecting closer to $96k, within the range in the posting. Is there flexibility there? Either way, I'm keen to make this work.
note: Never accept on the call: ask for it in writing, give a specific day, and put your number down now so the written offer can reflect it.

situation: Got an offer as senior UX researcher at Hollis Health for $118k. I asked for $128k and the recruiter, Megan, came back saying $118k is the top of the band. I still want the job.
reply: Thanks for checking, Megan, and for going back to them. I'm excited about this role, so let's look at the rest of the package. Would they do a $7,500 signing bonus and a formal salary review at six months instead of twelve? With those two in writing, I'm ready to sign this week.
note: After a firm no on base salary: move to one-off money and timing, and make the path to yes explicit.

situation: 我做手工陶瓷杯，零售价每只180元。一家买手店的陈老板想上架我的杯子，提出寄售，卖出后他抽40%，卖不掉退回给我。我更想让他按零售价的六折直接进货，首单30只；如果只能寄售，抽成30%我也能接受。
reply: 陈老板，谢谢您喜欢这批杯子，能在您店里上架我很开心。寄售抽40%对我来说偏高，想跟您商量直接进货：每只按零售价的六折，108元，首单30只，一共3240元。这样您的进货价是固定的，卖得越好利润越多。您看可以吗？如果您更想先寄售试一试，抽成30%我可以接受。
note: 卖给店铺时，条款和价格一起谈：先提自己想要的进货方式和具体数字，再把能接受的寄售抽成作为第二个选项。

situation: I'm selling my 2019 hatchback, 48,000 miles, full service history, listed at $17,500 online. Private-party value is around $17,000. A buyer, Luis, offered $14,000 cash. I'd take $16,500.
reply: Thanks for the offer, Luis, and cash works well for me. $14,000 is too far under for this car: it has 48,000 miles, a full service history, and private-party value is around $17,000. I can do $16,900 if you can pick it up this week. Want to come and see it Thursday after 5?
note: Seller side: don't split the difference with a lowball. Counter once with a specific number just above your floor and one fact about value, then hold.

situation: I'm Alex. Got a written offer for Product Marketing Manager at Larkfield Health in Denver from the recruiter, Jordan: $112k base, on Maya's team, start Oct 19. Market data for the role is about $120k to $130k, and I led a launch at my current job that doubled trial sign-ups. I'd accept $122k.
reply:
Hi Jordan,
Thank you for the offer, I'm genuinely excited about the role and about joining Maya's team. I want to be straightforward about one thing: the base is at $112k, and for this scope in Denver I was expecting closer to $126k. The launch I led this year doubled trial sign-ups, and that's the work I'd be doing for Larkfield from the first week. Is there flexibility to get there? If base is fixed, I'd be open to talking about a signing bonus. Either way, I'm keen to make this work.
Best,
Alex
note: First counter on a written offer: one number slightly above your floor, the strongest reason framed as value to them, and a second lever so a no isn't a dead end.

situation: 我是自由插画师，作品集里有三本已出版的绘本。出版社编辑周老师想请我画一本24幅的绘本，但要求先免费画一张样稿看风格。我的报价是每幅1500元，不想免费画，但可以接受付费样稿，正式合作的话样稿费抵扣进总价。
reply: 周老师，谢谢您想到我，很高兴能参与这本绘本。样稿我很乐意画，不过我不画免费样稿，一张完整的样稿和正式稿的工作量差不多。我的报价是每幅1500元，样稿也按1500元收；确定合作的话，这1500元直接抵扣进24幅的总价。您也可以先看看我作品集里三本已出版的绘本，判断风格是否合适。您看这样可以吗？
note: 免费样稿也是价格谈判：给样稿报一个具体价格，再用抵扣降低对方的风险，而不是白做。

situation: Recruiter at Harrowgate Freight, Ana, emailed before my first interview (Thursday) asking my salary expectations for a senior data analyst role in Chicago. Market looks like $105k to $120k. I'm on $98k now and would accept $112k.
reply: Hi Ana, thanks for asking, and I'm glad to be moving forward. Based on the scope in the job description and what senior analyst roles in Chicago are paying, I'm looking for a base of $118k. I'm also interested in the full package, so I'm happy to talk about bonus and benefits as we go. Looking forward to Thursday.
note: Asked early: one number slightly above your floor, anchored in scope and market, never your current salary and never a range.

situation: A regional marketing conference asked me to run a half-day workshop on 12 November for a $500 honorarium plus travel. My usual fee for a half day is $2,500, and I've run this workshop at three conferences this year, all sold out. The organiser is Leah.
reply: Hi Leah, thank you for the invitation, I'd love to run the workshop on 12 November. My fee for a half-day workshop is $2,500. I've run this one at three conferences this year and each session sold out, so it tends to help ticket sales. Is there flexibility in the budget to get there? If the fee is fixed, I'd be open to $1,500 plus two free passes and the rights to use the session recording afterwards.
note: An honorarium is an opening offer, not a rate card: anchor on your real fee with one reason that helps them, then name the non-cash levers.

situation: I'm Sam. I have a written offer from Norrland Games for senior QA lead at $98k, and it's where I want to work. I also have a written offer from another studio at $108k. I'd happily sign with Norrland at $104k. The recruiter is Hannah.
reply:
Hi Hannah,
Thank you for the offer. Norrland is my first choice and I'd really like to make this work. I want to be open with you: I have a written offer from another company at $108k base. If you can get to $106k, I'm ready to sign this week. Is there flexibility there? If base is fixed, I'd be glad to talk about a signing bonus to close the gap.
Best,
Sam
note: Only mention a competing offer if it's real and in writing, and say which one you prefer; it's context for your number, not a threat.

situation: 拿到一家互联网公司数据分析岗的offer，月薪25k我挺满意，但要求每天到岗。我住城北，单程通勤一个半小时，上一份工作是两年的混合办公，交付一直按时。想跟HR王女士争取每周两天远程，又怕把offer谈没了。
reply: 王女士您好，谢谢您发来的offer，我很期待加入团队，薪资这部分我没有问题。想跟您商量一点：能否安排每周两天远程办公，比如周二和周四？我在上一家公司远程和到岗结合工作了两年，交付一直按时。如果一开始不方便，也可以先全勤到岗，试用期结束后再根据表现评估一次。您看团队那边有没有这个空间？
note: 非薪资条款也是谈判：说清要什么，理由讲工作效果而不是通勤辛苦，给一个退路，谈成后写进offer。

situation: Last Thursday I countered Arden Analytics' offer ($94k, I asked for $104k). The recruiter, Dana, said she'd check with the hiring manager and I've heard nothing since. I told them I'd give an answer by Tuesday 6 October.
reply: Hi Dana, just checking in on the compensation question from last Thursday so I can give you a firm answer by Tuesday 6 October. I'm still very keen on the role and the team. Happy to jump on a quick call if that's easier than email.
note: After silence, one short nudge that keeps the offer warm; don't lower your number to fill the gap.

situation: I'm Marcus. Offer from Fernhill Health for a senior data engineer role on their platform team in Seattle: $148k base, which I'm happy with, starting Monday Nov 16. I live in Austin and they offer no relocation help; the move will cost me around $9,000. The recruiter is Priya.
reply:
Hi Priya,
Thank you for the offer, I'm really excited about joining the platform team, and the base works for me. The one thing I'd like to raise is the move from Austin: I'd like to ask for a $10,000 relocation allowance, so I can arrive on 16 November settled and ready to contribute from the first week. Is there flexibility there? If a relocation budget isn't possible, a signing bonus of the same amount would work just as well.
Best,
Marcus
note: When base is fine, anchor on the one lever that isn't: a specific number slightly above the real cost, with a signing bonus as the fallback.

situation: Je suis graphiste freelance, Camille Morel. Mme Lefèvre, acheteuse pour une chaîne de magasins, me propose une mission de 12 000 € pour refaire leurs supports en magasin, à livrer en six semaines, mais payée à 90 jours fin de mois. Je voudrais 30 jours, ou au minimum un acompte de 30 % à la commande.
reply:
Bonjour Madame Lefèvre,
Merci pour votre proposition, je suis vraiment ravie de travailler sur vos supports en magasin. Un seul point à ajuster avant de signer : le paiement à 90 jours fin de mois. Pour une mission de 12 000 € livrée en six semaines, que je mène seule, je travaille avec un règlement à 30 jours. Est-ce possible de votre côté ? Si vos délais de paiement sont fixes, je propose un acompte de 30 % à la commande, soit 3 600 €, et le solde selon vos conditions habituelles.
Bien cordialement,
Camille Morel
note: Les conditions de paiement se négocient comme le prix : une demande précise, une raison, un second levier. Vérifiez ce que le contrat prévoit avant de signer.

situation: I've done the monthly bookkeeping for Tom's bakery for three years at $400 a month. Since his second location opened in March there are about a third more transactions to handle, and my rate for new clients is now $550. I'd like to move him to $500 from 1 January and I'd be happy to lock that in for all of 2027.
reply: Hi Tom, I've really enjoyed these three years doing your books, and I'd like to keep doing them for a long time. Since the second location opened in March, there are about a third more transactions each month, and my rate for new clients is now $550. From 1 January I'd like to move your retainer from $400 to $500 a month. Does that work for you? If it helps with planning, I'll hold it at $500 for the whole of 2027.
note: Raising a long-standing client: a number below your new-client rate, one reason tied to the work, and a price lock as the second lever.

situation: 我们是做员工餐盒的小工厂，给一家科技公司食堂供货两年，每份18元，每周五含一份加餐水果，两年没出过一次送餐延误。续约时采购张经理要求降到16元，说别家报16.5元。我们成本15.2元，最低能接受17元。
reply: 张经理，这两年合作得很愉快，我们很想继续给贵司食堂供餐。16元我们做不到，能做到的是17.5元，前提是续签一年。两年里我们没有一次送餐延误，这份稳定我们会继续保证。如果价格还需要再往下靠，可以把每周五的加餐水果去掉，这样能做到17元。您看哪种更合适？
note: 卖方被压价：报一个略高于底线的具体数，理由讲对方得到的价值，再用去掉某项服务来换价格，而不是白白降价。

situation: フリーランスの日英翻訳者です。新規クライアントのゲーム会社の山本さんから、ゲーム内テキスト約5万字を1文字8円で依頼したいと連絡がありました。相場は10〜14円で、私はゲームローカライズの経験が5年あり、用語集の作成とキャラクターごとの口調の統一まで含めて納品するつもりです。12円を提示して、11円なら受けたいです。
reply:
山本様
ご連絡ありがとうございます。ゲームのローカライズは5年ほど続けてきた分野で、ぜひお手伝いしたいと思っております。料金について一点ご相談させてください。ご提示の1文字8円に対し、ゲーム内テキストの日英翻訳は1文字12円で承っております。用語集の作成とキャラクターごとの口調の統一まで含め、そのまま実装いただける品質でお納めするための料金です。この金額でご検討いただくことは可能でしょうか。ご予算に上限がある場合は、納期や対象範囲の調整でもご相談に応じます。
よろしくお願いいたします。
note: 丁寧な言い回しでも、具体的な金額は一つだけ、理由は提供する価値で伝える。11円という下限は伝えない。

situation: I'm Jess. Offer from Calder Logistics for an operations analyst role was $92k with a start date of Monday Oct 19. I countered at $106k, and the recruiter, Tomás, came back at $100k. I'd hoped for $104k, but $100k works. I'd really like to start Monday Nov 2 instead so I can take a break between jobs.
reply:
Hi Tomás,
Thank you for going back to them, I appreciate it. $100k works for me. One last thing before I sign: could we move the start date to Monday 2 November? With that, I'm ready to accept, and I'd love the updated offer in writing.
Best,
Jess
note: They moved once on base, so don't push it again; switch to a different lever and get it all in writing.

situation: 我拿到一家新能源车企数据产品经理的offer，定级P6，月薪3.2万，薪资我能接受。我在上一家公司独立带过4人的数据团队，负责的指标平台覆盖全公司，同类带团队的岗位一般定P7。我很想去，希望把定级谈到P7，HR是刘女士。
reply: 刘女士您好，谢谢您发来的offer，我很期待加入团队，薪资部分我没有问题。有一点想跟您坦率沟通：这次定级是P6，结合我之前独立带4人数据团队、负责全公司指标平台的经历，我原本预期的是P7。这些经验入职后就能直接用在贵司的数据产品上。定级上有没有调整的空间？如果这次确实调不了，能不能在offer里写明入职六个月后按P7标准复评？
note: 定级和薪资一样可以谈：一个明确的级别，一条最强的理由，再给一个复评的退路，谈成后写进offer。

situation: Rafael, CEO of a 30-person startup called Loomwise, offered me the founding designer role on a call yesterday: $135k base, which I'm happy with, plus 0.1% equity. They have no designer yet, so I'd build the design function from scratch. Founding design roles I've seen at this stage offer 0.25% to 0.5%, and I'd accept 0.3%.
reply: Hi Rafael, thanks for the call yesterday. I'm really excited about joining Loomwise as founding designer, and the $135k base works for me. The one piece I'd like to discuss is equity: the offer is 0.1%, and founding design roles I've seen at this stage sit between 0.25% and 0.5%. Since I'd be building the design function from scratch, I'm asking for 0.35%. Is there flexibility there?
note: Base settled, so the whole ask is one number on equity; if they push back, vesting or a one-year refresh are the next levers.

situation: Sou fotógrafa de produto em Curitiba. A Juliana, da marca de cosméticos Flor de Ipê, quer 20 fotos por R$ 2.000 com uso ilimitado e para sempre, inclusive em outdoor. Meu preço para 20 fotos com uso em redes sociais e site por um ano é R$ 2.000, e para uso ilimitado eu cobro R$ 3.800.
reply: Oi, Juliana, tudo bem? Quero muito fotografar essa linha com vocês. Os R$ 2.000 cobrem as 20 fotos com uso em redes sociais e site por um ano. Para uso ilimitado e permanente, incluindo outdoor, o valor é R$ 3.800, porque as imagens passam a trabalhar para a marca em muito mais lugares. Faz sentido para vocês? Se o outdoor ainda não está nos planos, fechamos em R$ 2.000 agora e licenciamos outros usos quando precisarem.
note: Direitos de uso fazem parte do preço: mantenha o valor e negocie o alcance da licença.

situation: 我做育儿嫂五年，有育婴师证，上一家的双胞胎是我从出生带到两岁的。现在李女士想请我住家带她8个月大的宝宝，开价每月7500元、每月休4天。我问过家政公司，像我这样的经验在本地一般是8500到9500元。我想谈到9000，最低能接受8500。
reply: 李女士，谢谢您信任我，我也很想来照顾宝宝。工资这块想跟您商量一下：您开的是每月7500元，我做育儿嫂五年，有育婴师证，上一家的双胞胎是我从出生带到两岁的，这样的经验在本地一般是8500到9500元。我想请您按每月9000元来定，宝宝交给我，您上班可以放心。您看这个数可以吗？如果工资上有难处，每月休息能不能从4天调到5天？
note: 报一个具体数字，理由讲经验和对方能得到的放心，不讲自己家里缺钱；再给一个工资以外的选项。

situation: I'm Nadia. I've been a contractor on Brightwater Labs' data team for 10 months and rebuilt their billing pipeline, which cut month-end close from five days to two. My manager Owen just offered to convert me to full-time at $115k base; similar roles in our city pay $125k to $135k, and I'd accept $125k.
reply: Hi Owen, thank you, I'd really like to join the team properly and keep building on the billing work. The offer is at $115k, and for this role in our city the range I'm seeing is $125k to $135k, so I was expecting closer to $128k. You'd be hiring someone with no ramp-up: I already know the systems, and the billing pipeline rebuild took month-end close from five days to two. Is there flexibility to get to $128k? If base is tight, I'm also happy to talk about a salary review at six months.
note: Converting from contractor: the strongest reason is the proven work and zero ramp-up, not what you used to bill.

situation: Hollis, who runs the Copper Kettle bar, asked my four-piece jazz band to play three hours every Saturday night in November for $200 a night plus drinks. We usually get $500 for a three-hour set, and the last two times we played there the bar was full past midnight. I'd accept $400.
reply: Hi Hollis, thanks for asking us back, we'd love to do Saturdays in November. For a three-hour set with four players our fee is $500 a night, and the last two times we played, the bar was full past midnight, so it tends to pay for itself. Can you get to $500? If that's a stretch, we could do $450 a night for all the November Saturdays booked together.
note: A venue's first figure is an opening offer: anchor on your real fee with the reason that matters to them, and trade a little price for a bigger booking.

situation: I'm Leila. Pinecrest Books offered me a four-day-week content lead role at $72k, which is 0.8 of the $90k full-time salary, and four days is exactly what I wanted. But the job description lists the same scope as the full-time version they advertised in spring. I'd like $80k for that scope, or the scope cut to fit four days at $72k. The recruiter is Ben.
reply:
Hi Ben,
Thank you for the offer. A four-day week is exactly what I was looking for, and I'm excited about the role. One thing I want to raise: the offer is $72k, 0.8 of the full-time salary, but the job description covers the same scope as the full-time role you advertised in spring. For that scope, I'd be looking for $80k. Is there flexibility there? If the salary is fixed, I'm happy to agree which parts of the scope come off so the role fits four days.
Best,
Leila
note: On a part-time offer, pay and scope move together: anchor on one, and offer the other as the second lever.

situation: I'm a freelance illustrator. Corinne at Hollow Leaf, a small tea brand, agreed my quote of $1,800 for their packaging illustration on a two-week turnaround, but now needs it by Monday 5 October for a trade show. My rush rate is 50% extra, because I'd have to move another client's work into the weekend; I could also do just the front panel by Monday and the rest on the original timeline.
reply: Hi Corinne, I'd love to get this ready for the trade show. To deliver the full set by Monday 5 October I'd need to move another client's work into the weekend, so the rush price is $2,700 instead of $1,800. Does that work for you? If the budget is fixed at $1,800, I can have the finished front panel ready for the show on Monday and deliver the rest on our original two-week timeline.
note: A rush is a change of scope: price it with one reason, and offer a smaller version that fits the original budget.

situation: Soy Sara Molina, fisioterapeuta. La Clínica Valdemar me ha ofrecido un puesto en el nivel 2 de su tabla salarial, 31.200 € brutos al año, pero tengo seis años de experiencia, dos de ellos en un hospital de Lisboa, que no han tenido en cuenta, y tengo los certificados de ambos empleos. Según su propia tabla, el nivel 4 (cinco años o más) son 34.800 €. El puesto me encaja y la responsable de RR. HH. es Elena Prieto.
reply:
Hola, Elena:
Muchas gracias por la oferta, me hace mucha ilusión incorporarme a la Clínica Valdemar. Quería comentarte un punto antes de firmar: la oferta me sitúa en el nivel 2 de vuestra tabla, pero tengo seis años de experiencia como fisioterapeuta, dos de ellos en un hospital de Lisboa, y creo que no se han tenido en cuenta. Según vuestra tabla, con cinco años o más corresponde el nivel 4, 34.800 €. ¿Podríais revisar el encuadre? Te envío esta semana los certificados de ambos empleos.
Un saludo,
Sara Molina
note: Con una tabla salarial fija se negocia el nivel: la cifra concreta, la prueba que la respalda y nada de motivos personales.

situation: I'm Priya, a senior account manager at Halden Media for six years. I'm being made redundant, and my manager Tom has passed on HR's offer of four weeks' pay as severance, with my last day on Friday 30 October. Before then I'm handing over our three largest clients. I'd like eight weeks' pay, and I'd settle for six plus keeping my laptop and an agreed reference.
reply:
Hi Tom,
Thank you for passing on the offer, and I want the handover of our three largest clients to go smoothly for everyone. I'd like to discuss the severance: four weeks' pay after six years with Halden is lower than I was expecting, and I'm asking for eight weeks. Between now and 30 October I'll be handing over those three accounts, and I'm committed to doing that well. Is there flexibility there? If the amount is fixed, I'd like to talk about keeping my laptop and agreeing the wording of a reference.
Best,
Priya
note: Don't sign on the spot; check your contract and any company policy, and get advice on the agreement before accepting.

situation: Soy Lucía Ferrer, ingeniera de datos. Datalún me ha ofrecido 52.000 € brutos al año, que me parecen bien, con incorporación el 1 de diciembre. Si me voy antes de marzo pierdo el bonus anual de mi empresa actual, unos 6.000 €, según mi contrato; también podría incorporarme el 1 de abril, después de cobrarlo. La responsable de selección es Carmen.
reply:
Hola, Carmen:
Muchas gracias por la oferta, tengo muchas ganas de unirme al equipo y el salario me encaja. Quería plantearte un punto: si me incorporo el 1 de diciembre, pierdo el bonus anual de mi empresa actual, unos 6.000 €, que se cobra en marzo. ¿Podríais compensarlo con una prima de incorporación de 6.000 €? Si no es posible, otra opción sería incorporarme el 1 de abril, ya cobrado el bonus. Puedo enviarte la cláusula del contrato que lo recoge.
Un saludo,
Lucía Ferrer
note: Lo que pierdes al cambiar de trabajo se negocia con una cifra concreta y la prueba; la fecha de incorporación es la segunda palanca.

situation: 我叫王璐，之前在一家外资零售企业做了7年采购，牵头过一个供应商谈判项目，一年降本12%，之后在家带孩子三年。现在一家家电公司给了我采购经理的offer，HR林女士说因为有三年空窗期，月薪只能给1.5万；我了解到这个岗位在本地一般是1.8万到2.2万。我想谈到1.9万，最低能接受1.7万。
reply: 林女士您好，谢谢您发来的offer，我很期待加入采购团队。月薪这块想跟您坦率沟通一下：现在是1.5万，这个岗位在本地一般是1.8万到2.2万，我希望按1.9万来定。我之前做了7年采购，牵头的供应商谈判项目一年降本12%，这些经验入职就能直接用上。薪资上有没有调整的空间？如果起薪确实定了，能不能在offer里写明试用期结束后按1.9万复评？
note: 对方拿空窗期压价时，不解释、不道歉，回到岗位价值和市场价；1.7万的底线不说出口。

situation: I'm Omar. In my first screen with Grace, the recruiter at Tilbury Parks Trust, I said I was looking for $90k for a programme coordinator role. In Wednesday's final round, the director said the role now also includes managing two field staff and a $400k grants budget. No offer yet; for that scope I'd want $102k and would accept $97k.
reply:
Hi Grace,
Thanks again for organising Wednesday's final round, I came away even more excited about the role. One thing I'd like to flag before an offer is drafted: when we first spoke I mentioned $90k, based on the role as it was described then. The scope now includes managing two field staff and a $400k grants budget, so for this version of the role I'm looking for $102k. Could you take that into account? Happy to talk it through on a call.
Best,
Omar
note: Revising your number is fair when the scope grows; say why once, before the offer is drafted, and keep your floor to yourself.
